account_balance_bounds_check.name: account_balance_bounds_check
account_balance_bounds_check.value: ("account_balance"."min_balance_minor" IS NULL OR "account_balance"."balance_minor" >= "account_balance"."min_balance_minor") AND ("account_balance"."max_balance_minor" IS NULL OR "account_balance"."balance_minor" <= "account_balance"."max_balance_minor")

custody_destruction_request_approver_che.name: custody_destruction_request_approver_check
custody_destruction_request_approver_che.value: "custody_destruction_request"."approved_by" IS NULL OR "custody_destruction_request"."requested_by" IS NULL OR "custody_destruction_request"."approved_by" <> "custody_destruction_request"."requested_by"

custody_movement_borrower_shape_check.name: custody_movement_borrower_shape_check
custody_movement_borrower_shape_check.value: ("custody_movement"."borrower_kind" IS NULL) OR ("custody_movement"."borrower_kind" = 'member' AND "custody_movement"."borrower_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("custody_movement"."borrower_kind" = 'entity' AND "custody_movement"."borrower_entity_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("custody_movement"."borrower_kind" = 'external' AND "custody_movement"."borrower_name" IS NOT NULL)

custody_stocktake_closure_check.name: custody_stocktake_closure_check
custody_stocktake_closure_check.value: ("custody_stocktake"."status" = 'open' AND "custody_stocktake"."closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("custody_stocktake"."status" <> 'open' AND "custody_stocktake"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)

custody_stocktake_sighting_shape_check.name: custody_stocktake_sighting_shape_check
custody_stocktake_sighting_shape_check.value: ("custody_stocktake_sighting"."kind" = 'sighted' AND "custody_stocktake_sighting"."packet_id" IS NOT NULL AND "custody_stocktake_sighting"."location_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("custody_stocktake_sighting"."kind" = 'not_found' AND "custody_stocktake_sighting"."packet_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("custody_stocktake_sighting"."kind" = 'unregistered' AND "custody_stocktake_sighting"."packet_id" IS NULL AND "custody_stocktake_sighting"."item_id" IS NULL AND "custody_stocktake_sighting"."location_id" IS NOT NULL AND "custody_stocktake_sighting"."description" IS NOT NULL AND length("custody_stocktake_sighting"."description") > 0)

index_split_document_version_unique.name: index_split_document_version_unique
index_split_document_version_unique.where: "index_split"."document_id" IS NOT NULL AND "index_split"."superseded_at" IS NULL

trust_ledger_node_shape_check.name: trust_ledger_node_shape_check
trust_ledger_node_shape_check.value:
("trust_ledger_node"."kind" = 'client' AND "trust_ledger_node"."client_entity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_ledger_node"."matter_id" IS NULL AND "trust_ledger_node"."parent_node_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("trust_ledger_node"."kind" = 'matter' AND "trust_ledger_node"."client_entity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_ledger_node"."matter_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_ledger_node"."parent_node_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("trust_ledger_node"."kind" = 'firm_funds' AND "trust_ledger_node"."client_entity_id" IS NULL AND "trust_ledger_node"."matter_id" IS NULL AND "trust_ledger_node"."parent_node_id" IS NULL)

trust_movement_shape_check.name: trust_movement_shape_check
trust_movement_shape_check.value:
("trust_movement"."kind" = 'deposit' AND "trust_movement"."counterparty_node_id" IS NULL AND "trust_movement"."method" <> 'internal' AND "trust_movement"."counterparty_name" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("trust_movement"."kind" = 'disbursement' AND "trust_movement"."counterparty_node_id" IS NULL AND "trust_movement"."method" <> 'internal' AND "trust_movement"."counterparty_name" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_movement"."authorized_by" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("trust_movement"."kind" = 'matter_transfer' AND "trust_movement"."counterparty_node_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trust_movement"."counterparty_node_id" <> "trust_movement"."node_id" AND "trust_movement"."method" = 'internal' AND "trust_movement"."counterparty_name" IS NULL AND "trust_movement"."authorized_by" IS NOT NULL)
